verdict.rationale: Anthropic says its skills follow the Agent Skills open standard, which "works across multiple AI tools" and is meant for cross-platform portability (docs-47, docs-67, agentskills.io spec). A hands-on probe showed the repo's spec-conformant skill folders can be installed by third-party tooling (`npx skills add ... -a claude-code`). However, the only first-party install instructions are for Claude Code's plugin marketplace and Claude.ai/API, and the one non-Claude use found required a developer to build their own model-agnostic adaptation (comm-17). Missing for 10: documented per-harness install instructions for Codex, Cursor and other agents; any demonstrated install into a non-Claude coding agent; a first-party multi-agent installer.
